description:
Sleep Music for Insomnia | Slow Bansuri | 1.5 Hours

It's 11pm. You tried to sleep an hour ago, and you're still wide awake.

The mind is still moving — running through the day, the conversations, the things you didn't finish. You don't need another meditation to follow. You don't need to be told to breathe. You just need a sound steady enough that the body finally gets permission to drop, and long enough that it carries you all the way through the falling-asleep window without ending.

This is 90 minutes of slow solo Bansuri in Raga Yaman — a deep, expansive evening raga of stillness and serenity. The Bansuri is the bamboo flute — soft, breath-driven, naturally rising and falling like a slow exhale. Yaman is the raga of evening turning to night: spacious, unhurried, slightly melancholic — exactly the texture of a mind finally letting go.

Set the volume low, dim the lights, and let it play. Stop trying to sleep. Let the music do it.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Bansuri — slow, breath-driven solo bamboo flute with natural breath pauses
- Raga Yaman — a deep evening raga of stillness, the channel's proven sleep raga
- Soft tanpura drone holding the room open underneath
- No tabla, no percussion — just flute and drone with space to breathe
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz tuning, with a soft delta undertone for sleep induction

⏱ Chapters
0:00    Settling into the dark
20:00   The mind starting to slow
45:00   Deep stillness
70:00   Drifting under
85:00   Quiet close

🧠 How to use:
Lie down in the dark. Set the volume low — just enough to fill the edges of the room. Don't listen for anything; let the breath of the flute become the breath of the room and let your attention dissolve into it.

⏱ Best for:
• Insomnia and restless wakeful nights
• The 11pm mind that won't shut off
• Falling asleep when you've already tried once
• Long-form sleep that carries you all the way through
• Reading or quiet bedtime before turning off the lights

production_spec.notes: Raga Yaman — deep evening raga of stillness and serenity (raised 4th teevra Ma giving the expansive outward open evening character). Channel-proven sleep raga: Bansuri Sound Sleep hero (1.4M lifetime) used Yaman; Can't Fall Asleep (323K) also Yaman. TABLA: NO tabla per banked Bansuri rule (Bansuri sleep heroes all tabla-free). Soft tanpura drone only. Delta 3Hz binaural at -20dB for genuine sleep induction. LUFS -18 (quietest target, correct for sleep played low in dark room). Bansuri = breath-driven bamboo flute — long sustained notes with NATURAL BREATH PAUSES between phrases (this is critical — the spaces are as important as the notes). Soft airy tone, not bright. 90min = 3-4 Suno clips of 2-3min each + loop extension. Sleep ships are forgiving on loop seams since listeners are drifting off. EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION (one strong metaphor per clip): clip 1: 'like the body finally being given permission to drop into sleep' · clip 2: 'the breath of the flute becoming the breath of the room' · clip 3: 'the 11pm mind finally getting somewhere to land'. STRATEGIC NOTE: this ship maintains Friday channel momentum while protecting Mon Sitar swing — don't over-produce. Quality matters but cinematic ambition is wrong target. Aim for 'gentle and unbroken' over 'dramatic'.
